Name: Lumisteria Better Giant Crops
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod improve the giant crop yield when destroyed, based on farming skill level.
Every vanilla giant crop is boosted (for memory they are : cauliflower, melon, pumpkin, powdermelon, and ???)
The configuration options are :
- Chance of extra drop at lvl 7 of farming
- Chance of extra drop at lvl 10 of farming
- Chance of extra drop at lvl 13 of farming
- Chance of seeds drop.

Each of those settings are common for all crops (except ??? for the seeds), and are having a chance of 1 by default.
The seeds drop is allowing to replant a 3*3 giant crops with possibly a few extra.
Each extra drop for each skill level will be around 5-9 extra crops, cumulative. So at max level and with buff, you can obtain 40 crops from one giant crop! This number is lower for ??? giant crop since it's special.

Lvl 13 of farming is obtainable with farmer's lunch, but there's a lot of modded options you can use too.

The config options are here to give you opportunity to customise your experience. So if you feel some things are too powerful, feel free to adjust!
